name: Murder at the Manor
description: A guest lies dead at the manor. Each suspect was in a different room with a different motive. Work out whodunit.
clues: If Fairfax goes with Blackmail, then Jealousy goes with Bathing.
Between Grimsby and Holloway, one goes with Inheritance and the other with Jealousy.
Either Fairfax goes with Bathing, or Holloway goes with Jealousy — but not both.
Blackmail goes with at least one of Grimsby or Gardening.
